scientific_question: Can completed same-direction OKX BTC-USDT spot and BTC-USDT-SWAP aggressive-flow displacement, reinforced by swap open-interest state, identify a still-uncompleted Bybit BTCUSDT delivery to frozen external liquidity with enough incremental probability quality and after-cost account expectancy?
smc_ict_translation: The previous complete Bybit five-minute high and low are frozen external liquidity.
OKX spot and swap must complete displacement in the same direction with aligned aggressive flow while Bybit remains inside the frozen range.
This is three-market SMT non-confirmation: cash and swap have delivered but the Bybit account market has not.
One model may accept same-direction delivery or stay flat; it cannot invent reversal, another setup, target or stop.

sources.availability_clock: Tardis local_timestamp; row order is retained within each source file

event.structure: previous complete Bybit five-minute executable-mid high and low, available only after the bar completes

model.calibration: one isotonic map fit only on the chronological calibration date

decision.label: OKX-direction frozen Bybit external-liquidity boundary reached before the opposing boundary
decision.authorization: positive expected net basis points and calibrated probability at least two percentage points above the structural baseline

account.counterfactual_winner_removal: remove ceil(10 percent) of positive 12bp event keys before complete chronological one-slot replay

failure_rule: Any failed fit gate keeps development sealed and retires the exact information unit without model, feature, event, latency, target, stop, risk, leverage or sizing salvage.
